title: Interdependence
hook: Your output problem might actually be a sleep problem. Things are more connected than they look.
statement: Everything affects everything, so very few problems are truly isolated.
explainer: When areas are tightly linked, the thing you notice is rarely the cause. Fix the root connection and several problems get better at once.
sop: Pick a problem you've been treating as separate.
List 2 or 3 connected areas and score each link 1 to 10.
Trace which connection might be the real root.
Fix the root first, not the symptom you noticed.
Watch the other areas. A real fix improves more than one thing.
equation_example: Sleep-to-Energy 8, Energy-to-Output 7, Stress-to-Health 6. 8 + 7 + 6 = 21. Higher means things are tightly linked, so one fix ripples everywhere. Lower means the areas are more separate and fixes stay contained.
question: Pick one problem and write down three other things it's connected to.
closing_statement: Nothing you fix stays isolated for long.
caption:
Principle Nº 125: Interdependence

Your output problem might actually be a sleep problem. Things are more connected than they look.

Everything affects everything, so very few problems are truly isolated.

Your turn: Pick one problem and write down three other things it's connected to.
